lines.text: Many learners say: Is raining now.
English needs a subject, even for weather.

data.why: English needs a subject, even for weather.

native.tip: 天気でも主語の it が必要。日本語は主語を省けるけど、英語は省けない！
native.caption: “Is raining now.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語では主語を省けますが、英語は天気の話でも主語が必要です。“It is raining now.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“It”。天気の文には it を。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: English needs a subject, even for weather. Use it.
en.caption: Do you say “Is raining now.”? 😅 Japanese can drop the subject, but English cannot, even for weather. The natural way is “It is raining now.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
